notes:
Account background: payment-facing contact center that also handles PHI for telemedicine reimbursements. Strong compliance posture — PCI for card processing paths, HIPAA/PHI controls for patient data. Primary asks: private/VPC deployment, immutable audit logs with 7+ year retention, SSO (SAML/SCIM), KMS/HSM-backed key management, ability to redact PHI and maintain token-level cost visibility.

Current POC scope (requested): 2-week pilot running agent-assist + ticket summarization flows. Focus metrics: P95 latency for assist < 350ms for short completions, ticket-summary quality > 0.85 (human eval), system must sustain 4k–7k requests/min during peak batch windows without error rate > 0.5%. Need model routing: primary high-accuracy variant for sensitive flows, low-cost quantized variant for bulk summaries, and automatic fallback in case of capacity.

Customer comments/shorthand: "We cannot send raw PHI to public endpoints — VPC non-negotiable." — Head of Support. Security: "We will require yearly penetration test reports plus SOC2 Type II attestation." Procurement: two-stage (POC -> Pilot -> Reserved Dedicated capacity).

Open items: legal to scope PCI boundary (payment API vs support transcripts), confirm EU data residency pattern (some customers EU-only), finalize SAML metadata from Okta (IdP).

Links: pricing + POC SOW in Drive, security questionnaire submitted (Gmail thread-CA_orchid_security_20260302). Jira tickets created for infra questions: POC-78 (VPC networking), SEC-421 (audit log format).
